findings.summary: The sample data contradicts itself across tasks: the same employees and departments have different salaries and averages, so the printed results cannot all be right.
findings.evidence: Asha is 72000 (Q2, Q7), 95000 (Q34) and 90000 (Q37, Q38). Dept 10 average is 98750.00 (Q18) but 80000 (Q38). Ravi is 65000 (Q7) but 91000 (Q56). Max salary is 150000 (Q15) while the 2nd and 3rd highest are 95000 and 88000 (Q51, Q52).
findings.fix: Define one salary table for the sample data and recompute every result from it (Q7, Q15, Q18, Q29, Q34, Q37, Q38, Q51, Q52, Q56, Q60).
